resources.string: Show your Grafana dashboard or playlist while the TV is idle. Your artwork settings are kept.
Paste a dashboard link, or a Grafana playlist link to rotate through several dashboards. Kiosk and refresh options in the link are preserved.
Use the browser link from Grafana. Leave empty to remove it. Sign in through the preview, without putting a password in the URL.
Enter an HTTP or HTTPS address without a username or password, or leave it empty.
Sign in here if your Grafana requires it. The screensaver shares this browser session. Some sign-in pages may need a keyboard or mouse.
Grafana normally updates data itself. Optional page reloads restart the dashboard or playlist; they run only while the screensaver is visible.
Add a Grafana dashboard or playlist URL in the screensaver settings.
Could not load Grafana. Check the connection and dashboard address.
The system browser is unavailable. Update Android System WebView and try again.
The dashboard did not finish loading. Check the connection and Grafana server.
The secure connection failed. Check the Grafana server certificate.
Star dashboards in the list to choose favorites. An empty favorites list asks you to choose them. Rotation runs only in the screensaver.
No dashboards are available in this organization. Check the list in the Grafana screensaver settings.
No favorite dashboards are available for this server and organization. Add stars in the dashboard list in the Grafana screensaver settings.
Long dashboards move gently down and back up, pausing at the ends. Only in the screensaver; preview stays under your control.
